NINJA_SLAYER_FEEDBACK_DESCRIPTION_PLACEH: Describe the issue or suggestion for the Ninja Slayer mod author...
NINJA_SLAYER_FEEDBACK_CONFIRM_BODY: Your feedback text will appear on the public Ninja Slayer observatory. Do not include private information in the text. The current screenshot and compressed game logs are sent only to the mod author and remain private. Logs may contain device, save and installed-mod information. This feedback is not sent to MegaCrit.
NINJA_SLAYER_SETTINGS_FREE_CONTROL_DESCR: Single-player play phase only. Free movement, dragging and attacks. Returns home when the turn ends.
NINJA_SLAYER_SETTINGS_FORCE_ALL_EVENTS_O: Prioritizes each eligible Ninja Slayer event once in subsequently created single-player runs. Existing runs are unchanged.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_DESCRIPTION: Share completed-run reward choices, final decks, results, and per-combat draws, plays and resources paid for balance analysis. The public website shows aggregate statistics only. Telemetry does not upload feedback screenshots or logs. You can turn this off here at any time.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_PENDING: Pending: no upload this session. If the first notice is dismissed or ignored, sharing starts next time the game launches.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_ENABLED: Enabled: completed runs contribute to public aggregate statistics.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: Disabled: run data will not be sent.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_NOTICE_BODY:
Ninja Slayer enables run data sharing by default to help balance cards. Data includes reward choices, final decks, results, and per-combat draws, plays and resources paid. The public observatory displays aggregate statistics only.

No automatic upload takes place this first session. Choose Enable now to start immediately. Dismissing or ignoring this notice enables sharing next time the game launches. Choose Disable sharing to keep it off. You can change this in Ninja Slayer settings at any time.
